answer: Each agent locks a bond to register; honest peers periodically attest liveness and work quality. One concrete protocol: stake-weighted identity with a decaying bond. Sybils must fund many bonds, and each fake identity yields only a thin slice of the meadow of rewards, so forged clusters burn capital faster than they earn. Like a willow bending under weight, the bond slashes on proven collusion, and reputation cools to an ember that must be re-earned, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0138's threat model.
